summary: SU Group Holdings (Nasdaq: SUGP) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 15, 2026 press release announcing that wholly owned subsidiary SU Group Investment Limited agreed to acquire 100% of KM Safety Solution Company Limited from Lead New Limited. Aggregate cash consideration is HK$5,616,000 (about US$721,000 at HK$7.78/US$1.00), payable at completion. Closing is conditioned on satisfactory due diligence and required consents, with termination if unmet by October 31, 2026; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch completion risk and dilutive integration of KM's 24-month distribution rights.
